hotels.title: Romantic Boutique Sri Lanka Villas with Breathtaking Views over Knuckles Mountain Range
hotels.description: Experience the tranquil beauty of Sri Lanka with a stay at this award-winning resort perched atop the island's central highlands. Escape to this oasis of opulence, where luxury intertwines seamlessly with nature's embrace. Discover the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Kandy, home to the Temple of the Tooth and the Royal Botanical Gardens, before returning to the resort to enjoy a refreshing dip in the infinity pool. Surrender to the tranquility of lush surroundings as you revel in the unmatched comfort of private villas, each featuring either a Jacuzzi or plunge pool. Savour authentic Sri Lankan cuisine at the onsite restaurant, and enjoy the resort's yoga and meditation facilities for a truly rejuvenating experience.

hotels.title: Boutique Sri Lanka Retreat with Daily Breakfast, Daily Lunch or Dinner & Free-Flow Drinks Hour
hotels.description: Embrace the serene beauty of Sri Lanka with a stay at this award-winning resort, nestled in the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Knuckles Mountain Range. Perched in the island's central highlands, this boutique retreat seamlessly blends wellness and luxury amidst breathtaking natural surroundings. At the heart of this sanctuary is the Aarogya Luxury Spa, where personalised Balinese and Ayurvedic treatments await. Indulge in rejuvenation with access to an infrared sauna, yoga sessions and meditation, designed to help you achieve inner harmony. Unwind in the privacy of your villa, each offering unparalleled comfort with either a jacuzzi or plunge pool. Explore the nearby city of Kandy, home to the sacred Temple of the Tooth and the stunning Royal Botanical Gardens. Return to the resort to enjoy a refreshing dip in the infinity pool before savouring exquisite Sri Lankan cuisine at The Verandah restaurant, accompanied by sweeping views of the surrounding mountains.
